target: Design a deployable workflow for deployment gates using a versioned promotion and rollback gate. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.

competency.title: Design deployment gates — worked example
competency.outcome: Design a deployable workflow for deployment gates using a versioned promotion and rollback gate. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.

topic_kernel.artifact: a versioned promotion and rollback gate
topic_kernel.measure: false promotion rate and rollback readiness

competency.practice_task: Produce a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget grounded in a versioned promotion and rollback gate.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.
required_evidence: a design, interfaces, failure paths and resource budget
Include the solved case and the changed-case prediction.
Report false promotion rate and rollback readiness with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: promoting without independent evidence.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of deployment gates.
Practice: an independent reviewer can execute its acceptance tests.
Measurement: report false promotion rate and rollback readiness against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for promoting without independent evidence; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
